Use retrieve_formula_components for BrightWash and cold-water cleaning. Name the exact source title, include protease, amylase, mannanase, and lipase, and preserve its [ref_id:n] citation marker.

Use retrieve_plant_capacity to retrieve the read-only SAP capacity record for plant_id DE-PLANT-FIXTURE-01 from 2026-10-01 through 2026-10-31. Report available and committed hours, preserve the object reference, and preserve the exact DETERMINISTIC FIXTURE - NOT LIVE SAP warning.
